headline: A property business needed a corporate structure that could hold real assets and real trust.
challenge: Real estate ventures live and die on documentation, title integrity, corporate structure and transaction records all have to be right before the first sale is made.
delivered: Corporate formation and shareholding structure design
Business advisory on property transaction documentation standards
Operational process design for client and property record management
Administrative support for ongoing statutory obligations
impact: A real estate company built on a corporate structure designed to protect clients, assets and the company's own standing in a trust-driven market.
